settings.label: saw softer skin in a week

settings.quote: My eczema patches calmed down in four days. This $24 jar beat prescription creams.
Now it's the only thing I use. One jar lasts months and a little goes so far.
Replaced my lip balm, hand cream and night moisturizer with one little jar.
Winter wrecks my hands every year. Two weeks and the cracks are gone.
The unscented really is scentless. Melts right in.
My teenage son uses it without complaining. His skin cleared up too.
Postpartum my skin went haywire. This was the only thing gentle enough that worked.
One in my bag, one by the bed, one at my desk. Lips, knuckles, cuticles — everything.
Finally a label I can actually read. Four things. That's why I trust it.
